title: Aina za Nomino (Theme 3: Mapambo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows a compound noun joins two words into one new name with its own meaning, written as the dictionary writes it.
representations: word-part cards: mwana + funzi, mwana + sheria
pairs to sort: compound / noun with adjective
steps: Ask: do they make one new name?
Check how the dictionary writes it.

board.say: Neno jipya ni lipi na maana yake?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "mwananchi" and a sentence with it.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto anayesoma shuleni ni ___." Kwa nini "mwalimu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ambata huundwa kwa kuunganisha maneno mawili, kama mwana + funzi = mwanafunzi. Mwalimu si ambata.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto anayesoma shuleni ni ___." Kwa nini "mwana funzi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ambata huandikwa kama neno moja: mwanafunzi, si "mwana funzi".

misconceptions.ask: Maneno haya mawili yanaunda jina jipya?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ambata ni jina moja jipya lenye maana yake: mwanasheria, mwanamke.

checks.question: Ni nomino ambata ipi: mwanariadha, kiti kikubwa?
